name: Vernal-Veil
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by an ancient meteor crater near the terminator.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
the research outpost was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
There is money in aluminum here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
